testType: Expanded scripted four-action controller against live CPU with event-backed opportunity attribution
limitations: Scripted policy is not a human player; match statistics are not human win rates
Nine scripted fixtures per difficulty remain insufficient to estimate human skill, win rates or retune GK save probabilities
Tied regulation scores are followed by in-engine penalty shootouts and recorded separately
New kick.kind event distinguishes shot, superShot, pass and clearance; telemetry classifies actual event-backed attempts, while older kick counts still include all kicks
Performance on physical gamepads and phones is not tested
